# Alias AI

> Alias AI helps B2B teams build a predictable, qualified, consistent pipeline: targeted outbound, authority-building content and search, working together to start the right conversations. We serve B2B founders, consultants, agencies and service companies. We run LinkedIn personal branding, SEO & GEO (Google and AI-search visibility), and email marketing & outbound end to end, so the right buyers find you, trust you and book meetings.

## Services

- [LinkedIn Personal Branding](https://aliasai.co/services/linkedin): Positioning, content, targeted engagement, intent-signal tracking and account management, with inbound and outbound pathways.
- [SEO & GEO](https://aliasai.co/services/seo-geo): SEO and GEO optimized blogs, website content and newsletters built to rank on Google and be cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and other AI search engines.
- [Email Marketing & Outbound](https://aliasai.co/services/email-outbound): Email marketing and cold email outreach that reaches decision-makers and turns inboxes into booked meetings.
